purpose: Teach: なんせ/わき/黒く/ひとりひとり/チョット/微笑み/初夏/自在

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、なんせお父さんはお忙しかったぞ
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, your father was so busy.
lines.style: Soft opening, eyes distant in memory. Warm but melancholic. Voice trails gently, like holding something precious that's already passed.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、わきに本を積んでらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes — Grandpa, he did have books stacked everywhere, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Gentle agreement, almost conspiratorial. Knowing smile in the voice. Patient pauses between phrases, like she's savoring the detail with him.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんの髪が真っ黒く見えたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, your father's hair was so jet black.
lines.style: Same wistful register as before. Specific visual memory crystallizing as he speaks. Voice softens slightly on the color, lingering there.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、家族ひとりひとりを大切にされたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa, he cared so deeply for each member of the family, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Steady, reflective tone. No performance—just stating what she knows to be true. Slight emphasis on 'each one,' like she's counting them in her heart.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、チョットしたミスでお父さんが叱ったぞ
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, he'd scold over even small mistakes.
lines.style: Quieter now. Not sad, but acknowledging something harder. The memory carries weight. Pauses as if waiting for her to understand the whole picture.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃんのお顔の微笑み、忘れないわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa, I'll never forget the smile on his face, dear.
lines.style: Warm pivot. Voice lifts slightly—not dismissing the scolding, but balancing it with something genuine. Soft, sure. She knows what she's saying is true.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、初夏のお祭り、楽しかったぞ
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, there was an early-summer festival. It was such fun.
lines.style: Brightness returns, almost childlike wonder beneath the age. Eyes lighting up in the voice. Specific joy of one particular day, held clearly.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、書もご自在にお書きになられたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa, he wrote such beautiful calligraphy, with such ease, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Admiring, intimate close. Voice warm and certain. Final phrases taper gently, like she's offering the memory as a gift for him to hold onto.
